query mutationsResolveFormQuery(
  $id: ID!
  $requestId: String
  $operationId: String
) {
  metadataOperation(id: $id, requestId: $requestId, operationId: $operationId) {
    outcome
    operations {
      operationId
      fieldName
      expiresAt
      status
    }
    metadata {
      workId
      manifestationId
      etag
      title
      subtitle
      description
      language
      publisher
      publicationDate
      isbn10
      isbn13
      isbnMismatch
      pages
      contentRating
    }
  }
}
